v.title: Celtic Eyeing Ashour – A Midfield Power Move
v.excerpt: Celtic’s bid for Ashour could reshape the Scottish midfield landscape – a move that may also ripple across Rangers and even catch Barcelona’s eye.
v.body:
## Quick take
Celtic have quietly lined up a bid for Egypt’s promising midfielder Ashour, eyeing a fresh addition as Rangers look to shed a striker. The Scottish giants are reportedly willing to pay a fee that could set a new club record.

## What happened
BBC Sport reported that Celtic’s recruitment team has been in talks with Ashour’s representatives, who are open to a move to the Old Firm. The midfielder, who has impressed in the Egyptian Premier League, is seen as a creative engine that could boost Celtic’s midfield depth.

Meanwhile, Rangers are reportedly ready to part ways with a striker, possibly to free funds for a new forward. The dual narratives suggest a reshuffling of talent in Scotland, with Celtic stepping up to secure a player who could rival the likes of James Forrest.

## Why it matters
- **Celtic’s midfield strategy**: Securing Ashour would give Celtic a versatile link between defense and attack, a role currently underfilled. His vision and passing range could complement the existing core, tightening the midfield and providing a new outlet for the forwards.
- **Impact on Rangers**: The potential striker sale signals a shift in Rangers’ tactical focus. By reallocating resources, they may prioritize a more balanced squad, potentially altering their approach in the upcoming Europa League qualifiers.
- **Barcelona’s scouting eye**: While Barcelona may not directly benefit from this transfer, the move highlights a trend of top clubs eyeing emerging talent from less spotlighted leagues. Ashour’s development could serve as a case study for Barcelona’s own talent pipeline strategies.

## What's next
Watch Celtic’s official announcement in the coming days for confirmation of the fee and contract terms. If the deal closes, the next step will be the player’s medical and integration into the squad during pre‑season training. Fans should keep an eye on Ashour’s first training sessions, as his adaptation to the Scottish climate and style of play will set the tone for his impact in the upcoming season.
